id: title:Gilbert09:retry 408 request timeouts instead of failing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability for OpenRouter, BugSnag, and HubSpot connectors; treating HTTP 408 Request Timeout as a transient, retryable status alongside 429 and 5xx errors.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement: adding HTTP status code 408 to the set of transient, retryable status codes for warehouse ingestion connectors. This change allows ingestion jobs to recover from temporary request-timeout responses rather than treating them as fatal failures, potentially improving warehouse data availability. observations.behavior: Adds HTTP status code 408 to the set of transient, retryable status codes for the OpenRouter warehouse connector, alongside 429 and 5xx errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion jobs to retry transient request-timeout responses from OpenRouter rather than treating them as fatal failures, potentially improving warehouse data availability and ingestion reliability.
